journey.name: public node Lightning endpoint without route hints
journey.description: Requires the linked fixture issuer and a regtest Lightning node with announced channels that appear in the network graph Bitkit syncs. See README.md for setup; report this journey as blocked if that node is unavailable. The request's only endpoint is a bolt11 invoice from that node with no route hints, so Bitkit must reach the payee through the public graph. The flow stops before paying.

actions.action: Launch the E2E Bitkit app with Paykit UI enabled, the fixture issuer saved as a contact and linked as identities, and the Lightning node running with usable spending balance
Have the issuer send a new one-time BTC request with a future expiration whose only accepted endpoint is a bolt11 invoice from the public node, carrying no route hints
Verify the Payment Request confirmation screen (testTag "PaymentRequestConfirm") appears with the requested amount and the unavailable-payment toast (id "PaymentRequestUnavailableToast") does not
Press Android back to dismiss the automatic confirmation
Tap the pending Payment Requests bell (testTag "PaymentRequestsBell"), then tap Pay for that request
Wait for preparation to finish; verify the Payment Request confirmation screen (testTag "PaymentRequestConfirm") shows the requested amount with its payment swipe control (id "GRAB") enabled
Dismiss the confirmation without paying and verify no new payment was created
